summary: Polk County lookout tower erected 1963 at Providence; dismantled and re-erected about two miles north as the Green Swamp tower in 1990. No readable source says if it still stands.

facts.status_note: Taken apart in 1990 and re-erected at Green Swamp; no readable source says whether it still stands there.

events.note: A lookout tower erected at Providence, Polk County; the page gives only the year

corrections.why: The tower was taken apart in 1990 and re-erected as the Green Swamp tower, so gone describes only the Providence site.

notes_for_editor: Two Forest Lookouts pages agree on the 1963 erection and the 1990 move. Lakeland Ledger articles from 2006 and 2015 came up in search about the Green Swamp tower, and one 2006 search snippet describes it as standing on U.S. 98, but theledger.com and ocala.com return 403 to fetch, so nothing from them is cited. A readable copy would settle whether the tower still stands. Check whether the record coordinates mark the Providence site or Green Swamp, since the tower moved about two miles. The NHLR cache also holds Providence and Wausau lookout towers in Mississippi; those are different towers and were not used.
